definitions.explanation: An extremely brief moment in time. Originally a Buddhist term for the shortest possible unit of time. Used in literary and dramatic contexts to describe a fleeting instant, often at a critical or climactic point.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{刹那|せつな}、⟦{稲妻|いなずま}→稲妻：04989_inazuma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: At that very instant, lightning flashed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}った→合う：10466_au⟧{刹那|せつな}、⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高鳴|たかな}った→高鳴る：20269_takanaru⟧。
examples.english: The moment our eyes met, my heart began to race.

examples.japanese: ⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刹那|せつな}、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伏|ふ}せて→伏せる：11515_fuseru⟧⟦{難|なん}→難：00452_nan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}れた→逃れる：10425_nogareru⟧。
examples.english: At the instant of the explosion, he threw himself to the ground and escaped harm.

notes:
USAGE:
{刹那|せつな} is literary and dramatic. It typically appears in the pattern ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{刹那|せつな} (at that very instant) or ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刹那|せつな} (at the moment of ~). Not used in everyday casual conversation — ⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧ is the neutral equivalent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{刹那|せつな} (at that very instant)
- ～⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{刹那|せつな} (the moment ~ happened)
- ⟦{一|いっ}{瞬|しゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刹那|せつな} (a fleeting instant)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧ (moment/instant) is the standard, neutral word for a brief moment. {刹那|せつな} is more literary and carries a sense of dramatic tension. {刹那|せつな}{的|てき} (momentary, living for the moment) is a common derivative.
